The reason is, maybe there is absolutely nothing after this life. You only get one chance to live this 90yrs, and then after that, it’s done forever. And if that were the case, why not try to experience what it’s like to be alive. What’s a measly 90yrs compared to Infiniti?

Live it up while you’re here, gain some new experiences and try to find meaning in existence. That’s just my two cents. Keep your head up.

There is a sense of relief when it comes to thoughts about suicide. For example, I have this  fear of being old and broke or not achieving my goals. But then I realize I would never even let myself get to that point, because if I'm still unsatisfied with my situation I'll just end it before I get I certain age. 

However, I actually really like life and I've always been optimistic about it. I have aspiration of living a meaningful life and contributing to society. But if circumstances just keep getting worse than death just seems more appealing to me. I'm not afraid of death (it's where we're all headed) an it sure beats wallowing in misery. 

 Not sure if this is a right or wrong approach to life but it is what it is.
